\ud83c\udf52 DONAUWELLEN-KUCHENBOWL \ud83c\udf6b | 3 Portionen
ca. 470 kcal | 45 g P | 38 g KH | 14 g F

Teig:
120 g Dinkelmehl
45 g Sahne-Protein Back-Version*
3 Eier
180 g Magerquark
120 ml Mandelmilch
1½ TL Backpulver
Chunky Vanilla*
15 g Backkakao
180 g Sauerkirschen

Creme: 300 g Magerquark | 50 g Philadelphia So Leicht | Chunky Vanilla*
Topping: 30 g Zartbitterschokolade

Alles außer Kakao \u0026 Kirschen verrühren. Ca. ⅓ Teig abnehmen und Kakao einrühren. Hellen + dunklen Teig auf 3 Boxen verteilen, Kirschen eindrücken. 175 °C Umluft | 18–22 Min. Auskühlen lassen, Creme darauf \u0026 mit Schokolade toppen.

\ud83e\udd5c PROTEIN-SNICKERS-RIEGEL \ud83c\udf6b | ca. 6 Stück
ca. 197 kcal | 12 g P | 14 g KH | 9 g F

Boden:
2 Eier
100 g Magerquark
60 g Dinkelmehl
25 g Sahne-Protein Back-Version*
15 g Backkakao
1 TL Backpulver
60 ml Mandelmilch
Chunky Cookie Crumble*

Creme: 25 g Erdnussbutter | 20 g Karamellkekscreme | 1 EL Haselnuss-Proteinpudding | 20 g gesalzene Erdnüsse
Topping: ca. 20 g Zartbitterschokolade | ca. 10 g Karamellkekscreme

Boden verrühren, ca. 25 × 25 cm ausstreichen \u0026 175 °C Umluft | 10–12 Min. backen. Auskühlen lassen. Creme verrühren, Erdnüsse unterheben \u0026 darauf verteilen. Schokolade darübergeben. Karamellkekscreme kurz erwärmen \u0026 drüberträufeln. Kalt stellen \u0026 in ca. 6 Riegel schneiden.
Tipp: Statt Haselnuss-Pudding geht auch Karamell-Proteinpudding.

\ud83e\udd54 KARTOFFEL-HACK-AUFLAUF \ud83e\uddc0 | 2 Portionen
ca. 562 kcal | 43 g P | 44 g KH | 23 g F

500 g Kartoffeln
300 g mageres Rinderhack/Tatar
ca. 200 g Porree
1 Zwiebel + 1 Knoblauchzehe
1 EL Tomatenmark
150–200 ml Cremefine 7 % / Sahne light
50 g Reibekäse light
Brühe, Paprika, Salz \u0026 Pfeffer

Kartoffeln sehr dünn hobeln. Hack mit Zwiebel \u0026 Knoblauch anbraten, Tomatenmark mitrösten + kleinen Schuss Wasser dazu. Porree dazugeben \u0026 würzen. Kartoffeln und Hack-Lauch-Mischung abwechselnd in 2 Formen schichten. Cremefine mit Brühe verrühren, darübergeben \u0026 mit Käse toppen. 200 °C Ober-/Unterhitze | ca. 35–40 Min.

SAUSAGE COTTAGE CHEESE EGG BITES \ud83e\udd5a 

Ingredients - 
• 8eggs
• 1 cup cottage cheese 
•1 ¼ cups shredded Colby Jack cheese
• ½ package hot breakfast sausage, cooked \u0026 browned
• ½ green pepper, chopped
• Handful of spinach, chopped
• ½ tsp salt
• ¼ tsp black pepper
• ¼ tsp garlic powder
• Cooking spray  

Directions-
• Preheat oven to 325°F and spray a 12-cup muffin tin.
• Whisk eggs with salt, pepper \u0026 garlic powder.
• Stir in cottage cheese, shredded cheese, cooked sausage, green pepper \u0026 spinach.
• Divide evenly between muffin cups.
• Place a shallow pan of hot water on the bottom oven rack.
• Bake on the rack above the water bath for 23–25 minutes, or until set.
Let cool slightly, then remove and enjoy!

chicken bacon ranch orzo does not disappoint \ud83e\udd53\ud83c\udf57\ud83e\udd66

ONE POT CHICKEN BACON RANCH ORZO
- 1 small yellow onion, chopped
- 5-6 pieces bacon (I like to use Center Cut)
- 3-4 cloves of garlic, minced
- ~224g (4 servings) dry orzo
- 3 cups chicken bone broth (I use low sodium)
- 1/2 cup half \u0026 half
- 1 packet ranch seasoning mix 
- Salt, pepper, garlic powder to taste
- White meat of 1 rotisserie chicken, shredded 
- 1/2 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
- 1-2 cups steamed broccoli (I just grab the microwave bags!)

In a large pan or pot, start by cooking your bacon. While it’s cooking, chop your onion. Once the bacon is done, remove from the pan along with excess bacon grease — I’ll leave a little bit in the pan to keep the pan greased instead of adding avocado/olive oil! Add your onion and cook for 2-3 minutes on medium heat or until slightly softened, then add garlic and cook for another minute.

Add orzo to your mixture and let toast in the pan with the garlic and onion for 2-3 minutes. Add bone broth, ranch seasoning, salt, pepper \u0026 garlic powder and stir until well combined. Bring to a gentle boil and turn heat to low and cover. Cook for ~10-12 minutes, or until most of the liquid is absorbed. 

While orzo is cooking, shred your chicken \u0026 chop bacon into pieces. This is also when I throw the broccoli in the microwave to steam! Once orzo is almost fully cooked and there’s only a little bit of liquid left, stir in your half \u0026 half and Parmesan. When those are incorporated, add in chicken, bacon and broccoli. Stir until everything is well combined — top with extra parm if desired and enjoy!!

\ud83c\udf7d️ French Onion Baked Chicken

This one is going into the meal prep rotation. \ud83d\ude4c\ud83c\udffc Simple ingredients, easy to throw together, and 52g of protein per serving. Comfort food that still fits the macros!

Ingredients:
• 4 chicken breasts, sliced into thin cutlets
• 1 can condensed French onion soup
• 1 cup French onion dip
• 1–1½ cups seasoned croutons, crushed
• 8 slices provolone cheese
• ½ tsp garlic powder
• Salt + pepper to taste

Instructions:

1. Preheat oven to 400°F.
2. Spread the French onion soup over the bottom of a baking dish.
3. Season chicken with salt, pepper + garlic powder and place over the soup.
4. Spread French onion dip over the chicken.
5. Top with crushed croutons and provolone cheese.
6. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
7. Remove foil and bake another 10–15 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through to 165°F.

Makes 6 servings

Approx macros per serving:
487 calories | 52g protein | 23g carbs | 20g fat | 1–1.5g fiber

Super easy meal prep and SO good. Save this one so you can make it later, and send it to somebody who needs another easy high-protein dinner idea! \ud83d\udc97

WELCOME TO DAY 1 OF CROCKTOBER! \ud83c\udf83\ud83c\udf42\ud83c\udf72

31 days of easy, high-protein crockpot recipes to make meal prep easier all fall long! \ud83d\ude4c

Today we’re making CREAMY CHICKEN PASTA \ud83c\udf57\ud83c\udf5d

\ud83c\udf72 Want more? Grab my Crockpot Top Hits Cookbook with 60+ easy, high-protein crockpot recipes through the link in my bio!

(Makes 8 Servings: Each Serving is 1/8 of the Crockpot or ~2 Cups)

Macros (Per Serving):
-487 Calories
-15g Fat
-46g Carbs
-42g Protein

Ingredients:
-2 Lbs Chicken Breast (907g)
-1 (23oz) Jar Marinara Sauce (652g)
-1 (14.5oz) Jar Alfredo Sauce (411g)
-8 Cups Frozen Broccoli (340g)
-1 Box Protein Pasta (392g)
-2 Cups Low-Fat Mozzarella Cheese (226g)
-2 tsp Salt
-2 tsp Pepper
-1 tsp Onion Powder
-1 tsp Garlic Powder

Instructions: (Link in Bio to all my Kitchen Tools)
1.) Add chicken, seasonings, marinara, and Alfredo to the crockpot. Cook on HIGH for 3–4 hours or LOW for 6–8 hours.
2.) Near the end, cook the pasta and thaw the broccoli.
3.) Shred the chicken, then add pasta, broccoli, and mozzarella. Mix well.
4.) Cook another 10–15 minutes until warm and melted.
5.) Divide into 8 servings and enjoy!
